summary: Tested Brand Hub and Campaign DNA integration for Kora OS. Fixed 1 backend bug (UnboundLocalError in resolve endpoint). All 27 backend API tests pass. Frontend UI verified - both Campaign DNA tab in Campaign Detail and Brand Hub tab in Demand Studio Settings are accessible and functional.

bug_fixed.issue: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'campaign_dna' where it is not associated with a value
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'campaign_dna = None' initialization before the if campaign_id block to prevent reference before assignment
bug_fixed.impact: GET /api/brand-hub/resolve endpoint was returning 500 error when called without campaign_id parameter

ui_elements: DNA tab with Sparkles icon in Campaign Detail tabs
Campaign DNA header with inheritance indicator
Theme tab shows Campaign Colors with Primary/Secondary/Accent pickers
Brand Hub tab with Sparkles icon
Brand Hub header - Source of truth for your brand
5 sub-tabs: Brand Kit, Looks, Templates, Messaging, Playbooks
Colors section with 7 color pickers (Primary, Secondary, Accent, Background, Surface, Text, Text Muted)

critical_code_review_comments: All UI components properly use data-testid attributes for testing
Campaign DNA correctly shows inheritance from Brand Hub with visual indicator
Backend resolver endpoint properly merges brand and campaign level configs
Color pickers work with hex values and show brand-level defaults
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand Hub and Campaign DNA features are fully working. Backend bug was fixed (campaign_dna variable initialization). All API endpoints respond correctly with auth. UI components render properly with all required tabs and sections. Campaign DNA tab shows Theme, Looks, Copy, Export sub-tabs. Brand Hub shows Brand Kit, Looks, Templates, Messaging, Playbooks sub-tabs.

mocked_apis_list: Instagram sync - /api/studio/instagram/sync returns mock success (as noted in request)
